description: Single storey front extension incorporating front porch; single and two storey side to rear extension; rear dormer with Juliette balcony; two rooflights in front roofslope and one in side roofslope; solar panels to side and rear roofslopes (Demolition of garage, side extension, and part rear extension)
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The window(s) in the side elevation of the proposed development facing towards No. 83 Howberry Road shall:
</p><ul><li>(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
</li><li>(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.</li></ul>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><ul><li>Reasonable Exception Statement received 05.09.2025;</li><li> HR81-AP7-101;</li><li>HR81-AP7-102;</li><li>HR81-AP7-103, ;</li><li>Preliminary Roost Assessment Report received 05.09.2025 Ref: 24_PRA_09_14;</li></ul>
